why: Needs the Ludo/text-to-motion generator. Tangential to ENGINE FIRST. Unblock when the operator releases credits AND a session has the generator reachable - **AND BOTH ARMS ARE ALREADY ANSWERED NEGATIVE - do NOT pay to re-run them.** `research/HIGGSFIELD_MMA_PIPELINE_STUDY.md` ran R104's experiment on Higgsfield: ARM A, 8 two-fighter generations (two prompt styles, seeds 11 and 37), ALL 8 came back as ONE BODY, and of the 4 armbar prompts NONE reached the ground at all (three stood, one 'sat' in the air). That study's verdict stands: for grappling, 'generation fails - one body, and composition 0/36'. What is left for R104 is the NARROW residue only - whether LUDO specifically (not Higgsfield) behaves differently, and whether a HELD pose is easier than the dynamic entries that were tested. Cheap to check, but it is a long shot: side control is a GROUND position and the generator would not put a man on the floor even once.
